cutoff.meaning: The end of the regular session on 8 September 2026, by which time the vote must have occurred.

negative_condition: The ordinance receives fewer than three affirmative votes, or the vote fails to occur, or adoption occurs at a later session.
positive_condition: The ordinance receives at least three affirmative votes at the 8 September session.

proof.meaning: The official record of the vote on Ordinance 2026-14 at the 8 September session.
proof.name: vote_record
proof.subject: Ordinance 2026-14

terminal_meaning: The question is resolved by whether Ordinance 2026-14 receives at least three affirmative votes from the five-member council at the 8 September 2026 regular session.
